maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling new single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are sold to private consumers, financed by mortgages, not paid by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Mainly grows by building and selling homes in its communities, though it has made some builder acquisitions (e.g., Jimmy Jacobs, Crosswinds, Liberty).

mission_critical.reason: Home buyers can easily choose another builder before purchase; homebuilding is a one-off transaction with no switching costs.
